dtype: bfloat16 by declared default; upstream auto uses float16
intervention: source-relative accumulated latent displacement projected separately into model and visible state
profile_target: FP32 projection RMS before state dtype cast; source-relative realized cast RMS additionally logged
realized_state_diagnostic_tolerance: absolute 1e-6 + relative 0.01; each profile must pass at every active step to claim realized-state match
constant_calibration: two constants: sum(native projected RMS) / sum(native residual RMS), one per model/visible profile; no outcomes used
extended_control: replay gains and rho=1.25 can exceed convex factors; record them, no clipping
map_source: automatic source/scout attention with prompt-only tokens; no GT mask
cost_policy: official n_avg preserved; cache prompt embeddings, scout image and arm-independent attention maps when RNG unchanged
deferred_plan_items: one-shot scalar on a specified profile
